CREATE TYPE datum_set AS(a text,b integer); PREPARE datum_union(datum_set) AS SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT '(hello,8)'::datum_set AS v UNION SELECT $1 AS v) q; PREPARE datum_distinct(datum_set) AS SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE n WHEN 1 THEN '(hello,8)'::datum_set ELSE $1 END AS v FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) q(n)) d; PREPARE datum_group(datum_set) AS SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) q(n) GROUP BY CASE n WHEN 1 THEN '(hello,8)'::datum_set ELSE $1 END; PREPARE datum_join(datum_set) AS SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) l(n) JOIN (VALUES (1),(2)) r(n) ON CASE l.n WHEN 1 THEN '(hello,8)'::datum_set ELSE $1 END = CASE r.n WHEN 1 THEN '(hello,8)'::datum_set ELSE $1 END; ALTER TYPE datum_set ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bytea
